 Hindrance at Site as on Date.
i. The Track Ballast is Still stacked in 50 % Area of PEB Godown out of 516 Meter Ref Fig No
– 10.
ii. 30 Nos LT Line Still Stand on their position and No Progress is being seen for shifting of Pole
and Cables Ref Fig No -11.
iii. 5 Nos OHE Mast foundation infringing the foundation work of Warehouse in Rail Side. Reff
Fig No-12 & 13.

 Assistance required from CWC/Railway official.
i. Removal of track Ballast from PEB Godown Area has required to Expedite because as
on date only 50 % area is provided till now for godown work. CWC required to insist to
Railway official for hand over to Entire Proposed area of PEB Godown by which Work
can be expedite and lead to Completion on Stipulated Time.
ii. As per Sr DEN/NFR/NTSK Shri Vivek Bajaj, the remaining area for godown work will be
provided after removal existing stacked ballast which is stacked since long time.
iii. 30 Nos LT Line Still Stand on their position and No Progress is seen for shifting of Pole
and Cables. A joint Site Visit has been Conducted at Site on Dated: 21.05.2024 and as
per SSE/Electrical/NF Railway the shifting and dismantling of LT lines and poles will be
done by CWC official.
iv. Alignment and GFC Drawing of Approach Road is required to fixe and issue to Working
agency.
v. 1st TDS duly verified and checked has been submitted to CWC official on date:
04.08.2024 and approval is still awaited. CWC official required to look into matter and
kindly arrange the early approval.
vi. Required to issue of Good for Construction drawing and design for Service Road and
Septic Tank.
